title: Enable inline click-to-expand photos and make upload completion feedback unmissable

requirements.text: Enable simple inline click-to-expand behavior for images rendered in the public media gallery (attachments) so that clicking an image toggles between its normal card view and an expanded, larger inline view on the same page (no overlay/lightbox).

quotes: I want to be able to expand the photos when i click on them.
1. simple inline enlargement on the page?

acceptanceCriteria: In the Post Detail page attachments section, clicking an image toggles it between collapsed and expanded inline states on the page.
The expanded state is visually larger than the collapsed state and remains within the page flow (no modal/lightbox, no background dim).
Videos are not affected by the click-to-expand behavior and continue to use the existing video player UI.
Image expansion works on both desktop and mobile layouts.

requirements.text: Enable simple inline click-to-expand behavior for images shown in the admin post editor media attachment list so that clicking an image preview toggles between the current preview size and an expanded inline view (no overlay/lightbox).

quotes: I want to be able to expand the photos when i click on them.

acceptanceCriteria: In the Admin post editor, clicking an image attachment preview toggles it between collapsed preview size and expanded inline size.
The existing Remove media flow (trash button + confirmation dialog) remains functional and usable in both collapsed and expanded states.
Videos in the admin attachment list are not changed to be expandable (only images toggle size).

requirements.text: Ensure the admin media uploader provides a clearly visible, explicit upload-complete indication after a successful upload, and that the completion state is easy to notice and does not disappear too quickly for the owner to confidently avoid duplicate uploads.

quotes: And tell me when an upload is complete please
admin uploader show a visible success

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful upload in the admin media uploader, a visible success state is shown with explicit English text indicating the upload is complete.
The success state remains visible until the user starts another upload (or otherwise explicitly clears it), rather than auto-clearing after a short timeout.
While an upload is in progress, the uploader prevents starting a second upload from the same control and continues showing progress feedback.
Error states remain clearly visible and do not get overwritten by a success state unless a subsequent upload succeeds.

constraints: Frontend changes must not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; no backend changes are required for these UI behaviors.
nonGoals: Do not implement a lightbox/modal overlay or background-dimming image viewer.
Do not add new authentication, paywall, or payment features as part of this change.
Do not change media storage, backend media APIs, or introduce new backend endpoints.
